meeting.title: Customer self-service portal – sprint two review

summary.text: The sprint two goal was e-mail sign-up and viewing bills.

quotes.text: Sprint two goal was e-mail sign up and viewing bills.

summary.text: Ahmad showed e-mail sign-up working on the test site, including the confirmation e-mail.

quotes.text: Sign-up with e-mail is done and working on the test site, including the confirmation e-mail.

summary.text: Viewing the last twelve bills is not done. It is blocked on the billing system API.

quotes.text: Viewing the last twelve bills is not done, it's blocked on the billing system API.

summary.text: Lisa found that the error message for an e-mail address that is already registered is confusing. The team agreed that sign-up counts as finished for this sprint and that the wording is a separate tidy-up.

quotes.text: the error message for a used e-mail is confusing, can we reword it?
The sign up works, the wording is a tidy-up.

actions.text: Reword the error message shown for an e-mail address that is already registered

quotes.text: Yes, small fix, I'll add it to the next sprint.

actions.text: Note the wording fix with the demo feedback

quotes.text: I'll make sure it's noted down with the demo feedback.

summary.text: The billing team says the API will be ready on 18 December, but their last two dates slipped.

quotes.text: the billing team says the API is ready on the eighteenth of December, but their last two dates slipped.

summary.text: The bills story cannot finish until the billing team delivers the API. The 18 December date is for the API, not for bills showing in the portal.

quotes.text: the bills story can't finish until the billing sort of team delivers the API
that's their date for the a p i. It's not our date for the screen.

summary.text: If the date slips again past the holidays, paying a bill by card moves out of the first release.

quotes.text: if it slips again past the holidays, paying a bill by card moves out of the first release.

summary.text: The team is hopeful but not confident about 18 December, and is working with that date for now.

quotes.text: hopeful. Not comfortable.
that's what we're working with for now

summary.text: Security wants a penetration test before go-live, and the testing firm needs three weeks' notice.

quotes.text: security wants a penetration test before go-live and the testing firm needs three weeks' notice.

summary.text: The plan assumes the test can run in the second half of January with no major findings. This is an assumption, not something known.

quotes.text: we're assuming the test can run in the second half of January with no major findings.
Assuming. That's why I said it that way.

summary.text: As far as the team knows, no slot is held with the testing firm yet.

quotes.text: they've not got a slot held for us yet
Not that I know of, no. That's why I raised it.

actions.text: Book the penetration test slot with the testing firm

quotes.text: Lisa, can you book the slot this week so we have it?
Will do.

summary.text: Because of the billing API, Mei proposed that release one has sign-in, viewing bills and service requests, and that card payment goes to release two.

quotes.text: Given the billing API, I propose release one is sign-in, viewing bills and service requests, and card payment goes to release two.

summary.text: Lisa pointed out that paying is what people want from a portal. Tom said Finance won't love the change, but he would rather ship on time.

quotes.text: Paying is kind of the thing people want from a portal
Finance won't love it, but I'd rather ship on time.

summary.text: Decided: card payment moves to release two. Sign-in, viewing bills and service requests stay in release one.

quotes.text: Okay, so decided: card payment moves to basically release two.
Sign-in, viewing bills, service requests. Release one. Card payment, release two.

summary.text: Two of the four developers have leave in the first week of January, so velocity will be about half for that sprint. This is a rough figure, not an exact one.

quotes.text: Two of our four you know developers have leave in the first week of January, so velocity will be about half that sprint.
About half. I wouldn't say exactly.

summary.text: Because the leave is planned, the team will plan that sprint smaller.

quotes.text: it's planned leave, we'll plan the sprint smaller

actions.text: Plan the sprint in the first week of January smaller

quotes.text: we'll plan that sprint smaller.
